UPDATE people_roster_requests SET state='invalidated',decision_note='The referenced shift or assignment changed.',version=version+1,updated_at=?
    WHERE company_id=? AND state IN ${pending} AND id!=? AND (target_shift_id=ANY(?::text[]) OR source_assignment_id=ANY(?::text[]) OR target_assignment_id=ANY(?::text[])) RETURNING *

INSERT INTO people_roster_templates(id,company_id,department_id,name,start_time,end_time,capacity,active,version,created_by,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
        ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET name=excluded.name,start_time=excluded.start_time,end_time=excluded.end_time,capacity=excluded.capacity,active=excluded.active,version=excluded.version,updated_at=excluded.updated_at
